separation_protocol: External implementer receives only the public W3/W5 specification surface.
Implementer freezes a content-addressed implementation before any held-out case is revealed.
An independent external custodian, not Project FAR authors, creates/selects and holds the W4-like cases and oracle/adjudication material.
Custodian records case hashes before reveal and releases the execution package only after implementation freeze.
Run FAR semantics and the preregistered simpler baseline blind; adjudicate against the withheld oracle after outputs are sealed.
Classify contradictions, implementation mismatches, and underdetermination separately.
project_far_must_not: author or select the held-out cases
see held-out case contents or oracle before implementation freeze
supply a reference implementation to the independent implementer
treat a Project-FAR-controlled model or person as the external custodian
count this handoff artifact as R2 execution
